item.tib: rigs sngags rgyal mo'i tshogs mchod bsod nams tshogs chen
item.coloph: ces de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo'i rgyud la tshogs mchod bsod nams tshogs chen 'di ni/ mched grogs bstan 'degs rnams kyis gsung gis snga phyi kun nas bskul ba'i ngor/ snyoms las kun grol grags pa can gyis rgyal rong rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing du/ sa rta zla ba brgyad pa'i phyogs phyi ma la phab pa bstan pa'i rgyan du gyur cig/
